translation:
Mačči d tabaḥnut i ilemḥen deg wakal n Yisrael? — ihi: Ulac tanbaḍt i wemdan ɣef tmurt? D tigejdit n tfasiḥt i yellan, maca:

Mačči d tanbaḍt i wemdan ɣef tmurt, yerna d akken i wudem akk: mačči d tirrugza i t-yeṭṭfen?

Ur yelli — tuɣalin: ula d netta, ula d Yiḥudiyen, ula d wid yeldin Fajr, ula d wid yessawalen "Ur nemmeslay ara", akk d merra.

— Ur d-ssawḍen ara.

Taseḍḍaft-agi yezwar-d asegzi n uselṭan: Timura Tigeldatin. Awal d nuḥ. Asirem d asekla. Ayen i d-yettwaxdem d ssifa. Awal-agi mačči d ayen ara yettwaqbel... — ih, ayen. Imir, tanbaḍt mačči d tabaḥnut; d aḥric seg wudem n yimezdaɣ.
